text:
This is major Lewis. We are flying in Aircraft Rosethorn 007. 
One time took off at 4am, refilled at Qui Nhon, and that where I bought my camera the PX - Post Xchange army store.
We flew back in about 11 pm at night. we were all over the country that day. There was rain clouds pouring down, you could rain cloud pouring down and then 15 miles miles away you see another one.
researchNotes: Cataloged on VN-0016. First appearance of Major Lewis (identity notes: research/people/major-lewis.md). The Qui Nhơn PX camera purchase connects to the Canon Dial 35 named in the VN-0023 comments — the likely source of much of this collection.
